    HIRE OUR SPACE

    Discover a unique hidden gem near to King's Cross and Camden Town. 120 seat theatre with natural light and full blackout capability as well as air conditioning. Fully wheelchair accessible. Plus two rehearsal/meeting spaces.

    Enquire about hire
    Theatro Technis is the original theatre company that founded this venue. Since the 1960s, it has pioneered diverse work and served its working-class immigrant community.

    George Eugeniou 10 June 1932 - 14 December 2024
